title: Grilled Tofu with Avocado-Corn Salsa & Dressed Arugula

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Meanwhile, place corn in a colander and rinse under hot water (from the tap) to defrost. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the bowl with the corn, along with the salsa, and stir to combine; set aside.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Sprinkle with cornstarch, chili powder, and salt on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Add tofu and cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
To serve, divide tofu, salsa, and arugula between plates; drizzle arugula with vinaigrette. Enjoy!
